title: HyDI: A hybrid Deep Learning-Inductive Logic Programming ensemble for multi-label classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.37740v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While attaining remarkable results for many applications, Deep Learning models are notoriously difficult to explain. This work introduces HyDI, a hybrid ensemble architecture for hierarchical multi-label classification. It combines a Deep Learning (DL) model with rule-based classifiers generated by Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). For leaf classes of the label hierarchy, the rule-based classifiers replace the DL model, leading to more transparent classification results. HyDI is applied to the Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) ontology, providing ILP-generated rules for 314 classes. For these classes, HyDI can generate global explanations as well as local explanations that combine visual and text-based descriptions.

translated_title: HyDI：一种用于多标签分类的深度学习-归纳逻辑编程混合集成方法
translated_abstract: 尽管深度学习模型在许多应用中取得了显著的成果，但其难以解释的问题众所周知。本工作提出了HyDI，一种用于层次化多标签分类的混合集成架构。它将深度学习模型与由归纳逻辑编程生成的基于规则的分类器相结合。对于标签层次结构中的叶子类别，基于规则的分类器取代了深度学习模型，从而产生更加透明的分类结果。HyDI被应用于具有生物学意义的化学实体本体，为314个类别提供了由ILP生成的规则。对于这些类别，HyDI能够生成全局解释，以及结合视觉和文本描述的局部解释。
tldr: 提出了HyDI混合集成架构，将深度学习与归纳逻辑编程生成的规则分类器相结合以实现可解释的层次化多标签分类，并在ChEBI本体上为314个类别提供了透明分类结果及全局与局部解释。
en_tdlr: HyDI is a hybrid ensemble architecture that combines deep learning with ILP-generated rule-based classifiers for interpretable hierarchical multi-label classification, providing transparent results along with global and local explanations for 314 classes in the ChEBI ontology.
